tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a local text file and return line-numbered content. Use this instead of shell readers such as cat, head, tail, or sed -n.

file_path.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to cwd or the MCP server working directory.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. If omitted, reads through end of file.

max_bytes.description: Maximum normalized file-content bytes to return before truncating. Defaults to the lower effective cap from FILE_READ_MAX_BYTES and FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.

cwd.description: Absolute directory used to resolve relative file_path values.
